query: SELECT "user".id, "user".username, "user".first_name, "user".last_name, (CASE WHEN "user".username = $1 THEN 1 WHEN user_email.email = $1 THEN 1 WHEN CONCAT('+', phone_number_country_code.phone_code, user_phone_number.number) = $1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS score FROM "user" LEFT JOIN user_email ON user_email.user_id = "user".id LEFT JOIN user_phone_number ON user_phone_number.user_id = "user".id LEFT JOIN phone_number_country_code ON phone_number_country_code.country_code = user_phone_number.country_code WHERE "user".username ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%' OR user_email.email = $1 OR CONCAT('+', phone_number_country_code.phone_code, user_phone_number.number) = $1 ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT 5;
